text:
maya: Heads-up — after the offload refactor on staging I hit a retry storm. Symptoms: a bunch of small inference requests all trigger page migrations, migrate fails fast, requests requeue, and the shepherd keeps trying -> livelock. Anyone seen this pattern?

jon: Saw it on canary yesterday. Same basic loop. Appears when host fallback is competing with async migration and we have no backoff/jitter.

maya: Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/staging/trace/0xabcde — you can see repeated `migrate_page` + `migration_failed` spikes.

jon: Quick stopgap I used: per-tenant jitter + token-bucket for concurrent migrations. Pseudocode:

```
if acquire_token(tenant) == false:
  sleep(random(5,50)ms)
  return FALLBACK
else:
  migrate_page(page)
  release_token(tenant)
```

kevin: That helps. Two additional ideas: (1) separate "suggested" vs "forced" demote flags — if demote is suggested, make it low-priority and don't immediately requeue, (2) limit cross-tenant steals so one noisy tenant can't trigger global churn. :thinking:

maya: Concern: small-batch latency — adding jitter/sleep could regress p95 for <32 token requests. We need a policy that protects latency-critical small requests while still stopping churn.

jon: Proposal: cap concurrent migrations per-GPU = 8, per-tenant = 2. For requests classified "latency-sensitive" (small batches, realtime route) prefer host fallback if token wait > 3ms. For throughput routes, allow longer waits. Gives us an escape hatch.

kevin: Also: implement token leases (auto-renew) so if a worker crashes without releasing token we don't deadlock. Lease=5s + renew on progress.

maya: Good call. I'll sketch an RFC for the PageShepherd interface:

```
class PageShepherd:
  def acquire_migration_token(tenant_id, priority) -> Optional[token]
  def release_migration_token(token)
  def report_migration_outcome(token, success: bool)
```

Tokens have `lease_ms` and `deadline`. Shepherd exposes metrics: `shepherd_wait_ms`, `shepherd_leases_active`, `shepherd_retries` etc.

jon: Minor nit: prefer token lease 5000ms with jittered renew window (renew at 75% of lease) to reduce stampedes on renewers.

kevin: Add metric `shepherd_suggested_vs_forced_demotes` and event counters for "retry_loop_detected" so we can auto-escalate to a circuit-breaker.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout r2025-11-23-1430 -> 3/3 healthy (no regressions reported).

maya: I'll include those metrics + circuit-breaker rule in the RFC. Plan: draft RFC today, ping @kevin for API boundary review and @jon for perf knobs.

jon: sgtm. Also add a small perf test: 1k tps small-batch mixed tenants to validate p95 under jitter policy.

kevin: If we go with host-fallback threshold, make it pluggable per-route via config so product teams can tune.

maya: Will do. Thanks everyone. I'll post RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
